method.compilation: one direct tagged pass with populated book.aux and book.toc; no book.out seed
method.instrumentation: pdftexcmds timer around pageref* inside gfbpagelink

timer_resolution_probe.interpretation: The installed LuaHBTeX/pdftexcmds timer reported a one-tick minimum in this microprobe; the per-call cumulative profile remains quantized and includes timer-wrapper overhead.

limits: Single instrumented pass; timing is a targeting profile, not a matched performance comparison.
Timer overhead was not measured separately.
The auxiliary files were generated from the equivalent deferred-check source with the same labels and populated TOC.
A direct pass is not the converged production compile.
The timer rounds each individual interval; the microprobe confirmed one-tick granularity locally, but timer-wrapper overhead was not subtracted.
decision: The instrumented timer reports 0.509705 seconds over 17,590 page-reference calls, about 0.20% of this direct pass; this is not an overhead-corrected or repeated timing. Page-reference expansion is not a useful production optimization target. Focus the next profile on hyperlink annotation and tagpdf link-structure hooks.
